warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: One flat can wrap, so there is a single image.

Two names are printed. 'OKTOBERFEST' is the largest text, arched across the top; 'KEYWORTH' over 'BREWING COMPANY' is a framed logo at the right. The reading above is the arched name in the brand position; the brewery logo is the other candidate.
The bottom banner reads '1 PINT (16 FL OZ)   6% ALC/VOL 19 IBU' on one line. The alcohol wording has no full stops and no space around the slash, and '19 IBU' follows it directly.
Warning is printed small at the bottom left over the illustration, in capitals, with 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' on its own line above the body.

In that small type the marks after 'GENERAL' and after 'MACHINERY' are a single blob a few pixels across; transcribed as commas, which the wording calls for, but the image cannot settle comma against full stop.
